title: callista luteola
intro: Callista luteola, commonly known as the Butterfly Pea, is a perennial flowering plant native to tropical Asia. The Butterfly Pea has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Its therapeutic actions include acting as a vasodilator, lowering blood pressure and improving circulation, as well as exhibiting neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of Callista luteola include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other polyphenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
